items.title: Clear task contract
items.question: Can independent readers resolve the goal and grading boundaries from the public or discoverable contract?
items.requirement: For each scored task, the solver-visible contract must specify enough goal, permissions, outputs, constraints and assumptions to justify grading.
items.scope: task; For each scored task, the solver-visible contract must specify enough goal, permissions, outputs, constraints and assumptions to justify grading.
items.measurement: Material contradiction/ambiguity count; requirement and boundary cases with resolved authority / identified cases. Assess independent interpretations and valid boundary outcomes.

checks.action: Extract goal, allowed actions, outputs, constraints and assumptions from solver-visible material; compare with scorer expectations for contradictions and boundary ambiguity.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Resolve material ambiguities through independent contract interpretation without consulting hidden author intent as authority.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Exercise independently justified valid boundary solutions under the same scorer.

scoring.0: Material contradiction or underspecification prevents justified grading
scoring.2: Public/discoverable contract and assumptions resolve material ambiguity
scoring.3: Independent solutions and boundary cases support interpretation

items.on_gap: Clarify the contract without revealing the solution or removing the intended difficulty; rerun affected controls
items.boundary: Clarify without leaking solutions or removing intended difficulty; a privileged reference solve does not establish clarity. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build a public-contract ambiguity review packet and boundary-case control set.

items.title: Discoverable grading requirements
items.question: Can the solver find legitimate authority for every material scored condition?
items.requirement: Every material scored condition must follow from solver-visible instructions or authority reachable under solver permissions.
items.scope: task; Every material scored condition must follow from solver-visible instructions or authority reachable under solver permissions.
items.measurement: Mapped accessible material conditions / all material scored conditions; entailment decisions for formatting, tolerances, defaults and preservation; independent blind requirement-discovery results.

checks.action: Map scored conditions to authority spans and adjudicate entailment, including formatting, tolerances, defaults and preservation.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Check reference integrity and condition coverage against the full scoring inventory.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Test authority access and independent requirement discovery under solver permissions without author hints.
checks.expected_evidence: Blind discovery paths and access receipts
checks.when: Only for authorized solver-scope access tests

scoring.0: Material hidden requirement has no allowed authority
scoring.2: Every material condition has accessible authority
scoring.3: Blind reviewers/solvers find required evidence without author leakage

items.on_gap: Expose the legitimate requirement or remove the unsupported condition with approved scope; do not hide new requirements in grading notes
items.boundary: Reviewer access is not solver access; feasibility is separate. Expose legitimate requirements or obtain approval to remove unsupported conditions, not hide requirements in grading notes. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build a complete condition-to-authority crosswalk and blind discoverability check.

items.title: Correctness and scoring authority
items.question: Are expected results and scoring semantics justified by authoritative requirements?
items.requirement: For every expected result and scored obligation, identify correctness authority and explicit partial-credit, guardrail, entity-linkage and protected-state rules.
items.scope: task; For every expected result and scored obligation, identify correctness authority and explicit partial-credit, guardrail, entity-linkage and protected-state rules.
items.measurement: Expected results with justified authority / all expected results; explicit scoring obligations / material obligations; contradictions and unsupported grading rules.

checks.action: Justify each expected result using specifications, verified data or independently reviewed reference outcomes; resolve contradictory authority.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Compare the scoring contract to authority for partial credit, guardrails, entity/value/destination relationships and protected-state obligations.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Check authority/obligation coverage and explicit declared scoring fields.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

scoring.0: A material reference answer or scoring obligation contradicts authoritative requirements.
scoring.1: Some results have justified authority but known material authority or scoring-semantic disputes remain.
scoring.2: All material expected results and scoring rules have justified authority and resolved semantics.
scoring.3: Independent sources and adjudicators corroborate the material reference and scoring contract.

items.on_gap: Resolve contradictory authority or scorer misgrades before qualification; a recorded answer may be authority only when its correctness is justified
items.boundary: A recorded answer or gold patch is not authority merely because it exists; no model-majority vote replaces correctness authority. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build a correctness-authority packet and obligation-level scoring contract.
